title: Azusawa Kohane — Can't Wait For The Show〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: A few days before Christmas
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Have you finished hiding all the presents, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm all done!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've also finished hiding the remaining envelopes containing the riddles we discussed. I believe we're all set to go now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, it's hard to believe that we're doing Christmas presents already.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I know what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Speaking of which, if we're at that ski resort on Christmas Day, then we might not be able to have a party with Miku and the others.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I don't wanna not do anything, you know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Then, what if we threw a party early?
I'm sure we can make some time since we don't have to go to school.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sure, why not?
We could even buy them some Christmas presents.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah! Oh, also!
What if we did something special to make up for us being gone the day of?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Something special...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Umm...
Let's think of that part together!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're joking, right...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, what if we did something like this...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: ...which was when you suggested that we run a scavenger hunt using Christmas presents!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My parents did that for me when I was little, and I remember having a lot of fun...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which is why I'm hoping that Miku and the others also enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Anyway, that's it as far as the rules go.
Do you guys have any questions?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: All good♪ To recap, each envelope contains a riddle, and the answers will give us clues as to where to look next!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And solving the third riddle of a set plainly reveals where the corresponding present is, yes?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's right! Sounds like you guys are good to go!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're also free to look at the hint included in each envelope if you have trouble solving any of the riddles.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, you included helping hints?!
I wanna find my present fast, so can I look at it right away?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, you gotta at least try to solve it on your own first!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing what our riddles are like since they're all apparently different.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, and I'd like to try solving them without looking at any of the hints.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay, let's get our Christmas scavenger hunt started...
Ready, go!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Whoa, this is a riddle?!
It just looks like a picture of animals and food!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Mine's... Yikes, a brain teaser!
How do I solve this one?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You two should be able to solve those.
First, try taking a closer look at them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Mine also seems to be a brain teaser...
“You see two bouquets of roses and three bouquets of lilies. If you combined them, how many bouquets would you have as a result?”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wait, how's that a brain teaser?
Two plus three is five, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Uh, actually...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Why are An and Toya giggling...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha! I think they're enjoying how you fell right for this riddle's trap, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's weird to see Luka with such a serious look on her face...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. It sort of is.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Of course I'm taking this seriously. I'm absolutely, positively going to find this present no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay, I've solved the first riddle♪ On to the second one!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I've also solved my first one.

rows.Speaker: Miku, Rin & Len
rows.Line:
What...?
Really?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yes, I found my present...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Congratulations!
All of you have your presents now!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Still, Luka, you found yours so fast.
You totally blew through those riddles.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Heh heh.
I guess I'm pretty good at these kinds of brain teasers♪

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You two were also quick, KAITO, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, I suppose it's a testament to my ability to think outside the box!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
As for me, I think I sort of got lucky.
Despite it being a simple word-association riddle, the second one ended up taking me quite a long time to solve.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It took you a little while to solve that first one, Miku, but you ended up making short work of the other two.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I just really wasn't sure how I was supposed to think about it at first.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we've all found our presents, can I open mine?♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, please do!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, I wanna open mine too!
Hehe. I can't wait to see what's inside.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I've also been waiting for this moment!
Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I wanna try solving everyone else's riddles!
Can you two show me yours, Miku, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, this ended up being really fun, so I'd like to see your riddles as well.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay. Then, let's swap.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They certainly seem to be enjoying themselves...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm glad we decided to run this scavenger hunt for them!)
